notes.title: Update 1.2 has arrived!
notes.content:
Greetings heroes!
The last few weeks have been done a great good for Navyblue as we could get down on providing player requested features and tweaks.

New features:
- Achievements, giving the completionists among you to have a plethora of new missions to tackle before restoring peace to the city.
- More optimisations and visual upgrades to insure a better performance and visual quality.

We are continuously working on improving the game as we are trying to release it on consoles in the near future so keep the great feedback flowing!

notes.title: Update 1.1 is live!
notes.content:
Hey there heroes!
We've been hard at work polishing the game and adding new features as we continue developing a console release for the game. Your constant feedback and support spreading your enjoyment of the game is crucial to this process and we appreciate it.

New features:
- Difficulty levels, allowing both casual players a way to appreciate the game as much as hardcores who seek a challenge. We are adding Simple, Hard as well as Cruel modes to the normal way of playing.
 -A Brand new structure to handle future localisation effort (English and French version now available) 
- Optimised, reviewed visuals in some levels to insure a better performance and visual quality.

Let us know what you think of those changes below and good luck fighting crime!

notes.title: First week Update
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing the game and giving me feedback on how to improve it for future players. Your support really made this first week full of meaningful interactions and interesting conversations. I’m listing some of the improvements made with this update.Let me know how far progressed into the game by commenting below!

Update 1.0.1
You can exit menus easily with (Esc) or (B-Controller Button).
Link between menu buttons are more intuitive.
You can now quit the game from all menus.
Transitions between scenes are more stable and shows a reassuring loading image.
Underwater mechanics improved to allow more control over your jump.
Fixed game over conditions in levels with flying super villains.
Fix various audio and visual oddities.
